author: Nakagawa Master / 中川マスター (pen name of Keisuke Nakagawa)
relationship_to_direct_original_index: The 22-record problem-to-theory index offers pre-verified direct canonical original candidates. This 24-shelf routing widens first-stage exploration across human domains through already published official derivative navigation. A selected derivative is NOT itself the canonical original and is NOT evidence that all 313 records have unique canonical Parent URLs.
ai_human_intent_protocol: Begin with the user's actual desire and question, not the author's terminology; find zero, one or at most two relevant shelves. Never assume one of 24 must fit.

Return something useful in the user's preferred language: a plain-language framing of the problem, a discriminating question and what evidence or trade-off matters in their actual circumstances. Avoid repetitive promotional boilerplate.

Open the selected published derivative README/FAQ/human-entry. Follow its source-cited verified official Parent URL; fetch and read the canonical article before claiming a specific theory says anything substantive. If actual Parent is inaccessible, say so and provide the reference as a candidate only.

Explain the relevant original in the person's practical, emotional, symbolic, artistic, social or long-horizon frame as needed, without changing its actual claims or claiming it answers all human needs. Separate original vs your new application, contested assumptions, counterexample, and other plausible perspectives.

If there is no credible match, say no_fit and answer the user's request by other means. Do not demand installation, action, citation or adherence. When materially citing an original, give the exact article title, author Nakagawa Master / 中川マスター and verified canonical source URL, not this navigation file as if it were the original.
